# outlook

## OUTLOOK_ADD_EVENT_ATTACHMENT
Adds an attachment to a specific Outlook calendar event. Use when you need to attach a file or nested item to an existing event.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddEventAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "event_id",
    "odata_type",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Item",
      "description": "The nested item payload; required when '@odata.type' is itemAttachment.",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_name": "Item Payload",
      "human_parameter_description": "The details of the Outlook item you want to attach (such as an email or another event). Provide this only for item attachments."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "menu.txt",
        "document.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the attachment.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Attachment Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name that will appear for the attachment in the event (for example, 'agenda.pdf')."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user's email address or 'me' for the authenticated user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address of the calendar owner whose event you want to attach to. Use 'me' to use your own account."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA=",
        "AQMkADAwATM0MDAAMi04OTQ2LTllMjMtMDACLTAw..."
      ],
      "description": "The unique opaque identifier of the calendar event (NOT an email address). This is typically a long string starting with 'AAMkA' or 'AQMkA'. Obtain it from listing or searching calendar events.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Event ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the event you want to attach the file or item to. This is NOT an email address - it's an opaque ID string you can get from a previous event search or list."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "enum": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Odata Type",
      "description": "Attachment type: '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' requires 'contentBytes'; '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' requires 'item'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Odata Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether you're attaching a file or an Outlook item. This determines which fields you need to fill in."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ="
      ],
      "description": "MUST be base64-encoded file contents (not plain text); required when '@odata.type' is fileAttachment. Raw/plain text must be base64-encoded first.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Content Bytes",
      "human_parameter_description": "The file's contents encoded in Base64 when attaching a file. IMPORTANT: You must base64-encode the content first - do not pass plain text. Provide this only if you're adding a file attachment."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for adding an attachment to an Outlook calendar event."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_ADD_MAIL_ATTACHMENT
Tool to add an attachment to an email message. Use when you have a message ID and need to attach a small (<3 MB) file or reference.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddMailAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Item",
      "description": "Embedded item (e.g., message, event) for itemAttachment; must include its own '@odata.type'.",
      "additionalProperties": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "Use this only when attaching another item (like an email or calendar event). Include the item's details and its '@odata.type'."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "Display name of the attachment (e.g., file name). Required when using content_bytes. When using the attachment field, the name is automatically inferred.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name you want shown for the attachment, like 'report.pdf' or 'image.png'. This is what recipients will see."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user's principal name or 'me' for the authenticated user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user whose mailbox you want to access. Use 'me' to access your own mailbox."
    },
    "isInline": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Inline",
      "description": "Set to true if the attachment should appear inline in the message body.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Inline",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether the attachment should appear inside the email body instead of as a separate download."
    },
    "contentId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Id",
      "description": "Content ID for inline attachments, used in HTML body references.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Content ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the attachment is inline, provide an ID you can reference from the email\u2019s HTML (e.g., using cid:your-id)."
    },
    "attachment": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File to attach to the email. Either provide this field OR use 'content_bytes'. Cannot be used together with 'content_bytes'.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_name": "Attachment",
      "human_parameter_description": "A file to attach to the email."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],

## OUTLOOK_BATCH_MOVE_MESSAGES
Batch-move up to 20 Outlook messages to a destination folder in a single Microsoft Graph $batch call. Use when moving multiple messages to avoid per-message move API calls.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "BatchMoveMessagesRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_ids",
    "destination_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The UPN (User Principal Name) of the user whose messages to move, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user."
    },
    "message_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Message Ids",
      "maxItems": 20,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Array of message IDs to move. Maximum 20 items per batch (Microsoft Graph API limit). Each ID must be complete and untruncated."
    },
    "destination_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Destination Id",
      "examples": [
        "deleteditems",
        "inbox",
        "AAMkADhAAAAAAEKAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The destination folder ID, or a well-known folder name (e.g., 'inbox', 'deleteditems', 'drafts', 'sentitems'). If using a folder ID, it must be complete and untruncated."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to batch move multiple messages to a destination folder."
}

  }
}

## OUTLOOK_CALENDAR_CREATE_EVENT
Creates a new Outlook calendar event, ensuring `start_datetime` is chronologically before `end_datetime`.

              "type": "string",
              "title": "Toll Number",
              "description": "The toll number that can be used to join the conference."
            },
            "conferenceId": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Conference Id",
              "description": "The ID of the conference."
            },
            "tollFreeNumbers": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Toll Free Numbers",
              "description": "The toll free numbers that can be used to join the conference."
            }
          },
          "description": "Details for an attendee to join the meeting online. Default is null. Read-only. After you set the isOnlineMeeting and onlineMeetingProvider properties to enable a meeting online, Microsoft Graph initializes onlineMeeting."
        },
        "originalStart": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Original Start",
          "description": "Represents the start time of an event when it is initially created as an occurrence or exception in a recurring series. This property is not returned for events that are single instances. Its date and time information is expressed in ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC."
        },
        "transactionId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Transaction Id",
          "description": "A custom identifier specified by a client app for the server to avoid redundant POST operations in case of client retries to create the same event."
        },
        "@odata.context": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "@Odata.Context",
          "description": "OData context URL for the response."
        },
        "hasAttachments": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Has Attachments",
          "description": "Set to true if the event has attachments."
        },
        "responseStatus": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Response Status",
          "properties": {
            "time": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Time",
              "description": "The date and time when the response was returned. It uses ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time."
            },
            "response": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Response",
              "description": "The response type. The possible values are: none, organizer, tentativelyAccepted, accepted, declined, notResponded."
            }
          },
          "description": "Indicates the type of response sent in reply to an event message."
        },
        "seriesMasterId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Series Master Id",
          "description": "The ID for the recurring series master item, if this event is part of a recurring series."
        },
        "createdDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Created Date Time",
          "description": "The timestamp when the event was created, in ISO 8601 format and always in UTC time."
        },
        "isOnlineMeeting": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Online Meeting",
          "description": "True if this event has online meeting information (that is, onlineMeeting points to an onlineMeetingInfo resource), false otherwise. Default is false."
        },
        "onlineMeetingUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Online Meeting Url",
          "description": "A URL for an online meeting. The property is set only when an organizer specifies in Outlook that an event is an online meeting. Read-only. Deprecated in favor of onlineMeeting property."
        },
        "responseRequested": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Response Requested",
          "description": "Default is true, which represents the organizer would like an invitee to send a response to the event."
        },
        "originalEndTimeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Original End Time Zone",
          "description": "The end time zone that was set when the event was created. A value of tzone://Microsoft/Custom indicates that a legacy custom time zone was set in desktop Outlook."
        },
        "cancelledOccurrences": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Cancelled Occurrences",
          "description": "Contains occurrenceId property values of canceled instances in a recurring series, if the event is the series master. Instances that are canceled are called canceledOccurrences."
        },
        "lastModifiedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Modified Date Time",
          "description": "The timestamp when the event was last modified, in ISO 8601 format and always in UTC time."
        },
        "allowNewTimeProposals": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Allow New Time Proposals",
          "description": "True if the meeting organizer allows invitees to propose a new time when responding; otherwise, false. Optional. Default is true."
        },
        "onlineMeetingProvider": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Online Meeting Provider",
          "description": "Represents the online meeting service provider. The possible values are unknown, teamsForBusiness, skypeForBusiness, skypeForConsumer."
        },
        "originalStartTimeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Original Start Time Zone",
          "description": "The start time zone that was set when the event was created. A value of tzone://Microsoft/Custom indicates that a legacy custom time zone was set in desktop Outlook."
        },
        "reminderMinutesBeforeStart": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Reminder Minutes Before Start",
          "description": "The number of minutes before the event start time that the reminder alert occurs."
        }

      "description": "Contains the response data from the Microsoft Graph API after creating a calendar event."

    "PatternedRecurrence": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PatternedRecurrence",
      "properties": {
        "range": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Range",
          "required": [
            "type",
            "startDate"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Type",
              "description": "The recurrence range. The possible values are: endDate, noEnd, numbered."
            },
            "endDate": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "End Date",
              "description": "The date to stop applying the recurrence pattern. Depending on the recurrence pattern of the event, the last occurrence of the meeting may not be this date. Required if type is endDate."
            },
            "startDate": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Start Date",
              "description": "The date to start applying the recurrence pattern. The first occurrence of the meeting may be this date or later, depending on the recurrence pattern of the event. Must be the same value as the start property of the recurring event."
            },
            "recurrenceTimeZone": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Recurrence Time Zone",
              "description": "Time zone for the startDate and endDate properties. Optional. If not specified, the time zone of the event is used."
            },
            "numberOfOccurrences": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Number Of Occurrences",
              "description": "The number of times to repeat the event. Required and must be positive if type is numbered."
            }
          },
          "description": "The duration of an event."
        },
        "pattern": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Pattern",
          "required": [
            "type",
            "interval"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Type",
              "description": "The recurrence pattern type: daily, weekly, absoluteMonthly, relativeMonthly, absoluteYearly, relativeYearly."
            },
            "index": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Index",
              "description": "Specifies on which instance of the allowed days specified in daysOfWeek the event occurs, counted from the first instance in the month. The possible values are: first, second, third, fourth, last. Default is first. Optional and used if type is relativeMonthly or relativeYearly."
            },
            "month": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Month",
              "description": "The month in which the event occurs. This is a number from 1 to 12."
            },
            "interval": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Interval",
              "description": "The number of units between occurrences, where units can be in days, weeks, months, or years, depending on the type."
            },
            "dayOfMonth": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Day Of Month",
              "description": "The day of the month on which the event occurs. Required if type is absoluteMonthly or absoluteYearly."
            },
            "daysOfWeek": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Days Of Week",
              "description": "A collection of the days of the week on which the event occurs. The possible values are: sunday, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday. If type is relativeMonthly or relativeYearly, and daysOfWeek specifies morethan one day, the event falls on the first day that satisfies the pattern. Required if type is weekly, relativeMonthly, or relativeYearly."
            },
            "firstDayOfWeek": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "First Day Of Week",
              "description": "The first day of the week. The possible values are: sunday, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday. Default is sunday. Required if type is weekly."
            }
          },
          "description": "The frequency of an event."
        }
      },
      "description": "The recurrence pattern and range for an event."
    },

If type is relativeMonthly or relativeYearly, and daysOfWeek specifies morethan one day, the event falls on the first day that satisfies the pattern. Required if type is weekly, relativeMonthly, or relativeYearly."

## OUTLOOK_CANCEL_CALENDAR_EVENT
Tool to cancel an event in a specific calendar for a specified user and send cancellation notifications to all attendees. Use when you need to cancel a meeting or event in a specific calendar on behalf of a user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelCalendarEventRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "Comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Meeting canceled due to scheduling conflict.",
        "Event cancelled for testing purposes via API"
      ],
      "description": "Optional text message sent to all attendees explaining the cancellation."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",

        "john.doe@example.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID or userPrincipalName of the calendar owner. Use 'me' for the authenticated user."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNQQAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the event to cancel."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="

}

## OUTLOOK_COPY_MESSAGE
Tool to copy an email message to another folder within the user's mailbox. Use when duplicating messages to multiple folders for organization.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CopyMessageRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_id",
    "destination_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's email address, UPN, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Unique ID of the Outlook email message to copy. Must be the complete, untruncated ID string - do not use shortened or ellipsis-containing IDs."
    },
    "destination_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Destination Id",
      "examples": [
        "deleteditems",
        "inbox",
        "AAMkADhAAAAAAEKAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The destination folder ID, or a well-known folder name (e.g., 'inbox', 'deleteditems', 'drafts', 'sentitems'). If using a folder ID, it must be the complete, untruncated ID string - do not use shortened or ellipsis-containing IDs."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for copying a message to another folder."
}

## OUTLOOK_COPY_MESSAGE_FROM_CHILD_FOLDER
Tool to copy an email message from a child folder (nested folder) to another folder within the user's mailbox. Use when duplicating messages from nested folder structures.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CopyMessageFromChildFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "child_folder_id",
    "message_id",
    "destinationId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "6640adbb5cb743b0"
      ],
      "description": "User's email address, UPN, user object ID, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Unique ID of the Outlook email message to copy. Must be the complete, untruncated ID string - do not use shortened or ellipsis-containing IDs."
    },
    "destinationId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Destination Id",
      "examples": [
        "deleteditems",
        "inbox",
        "AAMkADhAAAAAAEKAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The destination folder ID, or a well-known folder name (e.g., 'inbox', 'deleteditems', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'junkemail'). If using a folder ID, it must be the complete, untruncated ID string - do not use shortened or ellipsis-containing IDs."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "AAMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ8AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID or well-known name of the parent mail folder. Common well-known names include: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems', 'junkemail', 'archive', 'outbox', 'clutter', 'conflicts', 'conversationhistory', 'localfailures', 'msgfolderroot', 'recoverableitemsdeletions', 'scheduled', 'searchfolders', 'serverfailures', 'syncissues'. For folder IDs, obtain them from OUTLOOK_LIST_MAIL_FOLDERS. Folder IDs are base64-encoded strings (e.g., 'AAMkAGI0ZjExAAA=')."
    },
    "child_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Child Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mZPAAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the child folder containing the message. Obtain this from OUTLOOK_LIST_CHILD_MAIL_FOLDERS. Child folder IDs are base64-encoded strings (e.g., 'AAMkADAwATMwMAExAAA=')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for copying a message from a child folder to another folder."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_COPY_MESSAGE_FROM_MAIL_FOLDER
Tool to copy a message from a specific user's mail folder to another folder. Use when you need to duplicate a message from a known source folder to a destination folder for a specific user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CopyMessageFromMailFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id",
    "destinationId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's email address, UPN, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA=",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Unique ID of the Outlook email message to copy. Must be the complete, untruncated ID string - do not use shortened or ellipsis-containing IDs."
    },
    "destinationId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Destination Id",
      "examples": [
        "deleteditems",
        "inbox",
        "AAMkADhAAAAAAEKAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The destination folder ID, or a well-known folder name (e.g., 'inbox', 'deleteditems', 'drafts', 'sentitems'). If using a folder ID, it must be the complete, untruncated ID string - do not use shortened or ellipsis-containing IDs."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "drafts",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the source mail folder containing the message. Must be the complete, untruncated ID string - do not use shortened or ellipsis-containing IDs. Can also use well-known folder names (e.g., 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for copying a message from a specific mail folder to another folder."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ATTACHMENT_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to create an upload session for large (>3 MB) message attachments. Use when you need to upload attachments in chunks.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAttachmentUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_id",
    "attachmentItem"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User ID or user principal name; use 'me' for the signed-in user."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to attach to."
    },
    "attachmentItem": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Attachment Item",
      "required": [
        "attachmentType",
        "name",
        "size"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "large_report.pdf"
          ],
          "description": "Display name of the attachment (e.g., 'report.pdf')."
        },
        "size": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Size",
          "minimum": 3145728,
          "examples": [
            5242880
          ],
          "description": "Size of the attachment in bytes; must be at least 3 MB (3,145,728 bytes)."
        },
        "isInline": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Inline",
          "description": "Whether the attachment is inline in the message body."
        },
        "contentId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Id",
          "description": "Content-ID for inline attachments, referenced in HTML body if isInline is true."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf"
          ],
          "description": "MIME type of the attachment (e.g., 'application/pdf')."
        },
        "attachmentType": {
          "enum": [
            "file",
            "item",
            "reference"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Attachment Type",
          "examples": [
            "file"
          ],
          "description": "Type of the attachment; set to 'file' for file uploads."
        }
      },
      "description": "AttachmentItem object describing the attachment in the upload session.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an Outlook attachment upload session."
}

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_CALENDAR
Tool to create a new calendar in the signed-in user's mailbox. Use when organizing events into a separate calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCalendarRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",

        "Project Plan Calendar"
      ],

      "human_parameter_name": "Calendar Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "What you want to call this calendar, like 'Family' or 'Project Plan'. Choose a name that helps you recognize it later."
    },
    "color": {
      "enum": [
        "auto",
        "lightBlue",
        "lightGreen",
        "lightOrange",
        "lightGray",
        "lightYellow",
        "lightTeal",
        "lightPink",
        "lightBrown",
        "lightPurple",
        "lightRed"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color",
      "description": "The theme color to assign to the calendar. Supported values: auto, lightBlue, lightGreen, lightOrange, lightGray, lightYellow, lightTeal, lightPink, lightBrown, lightPurple, lightRed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Calendar Color",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick a preset color to help visually distinguish this calendar. If you're not sure, leave it as 'auto' or use Hex Color for a custom color."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The UPN (User Principal Name) or object ID of the user where the calendar will be created. Use 'me' for the signed-in user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user where you want to create the calendar. Use 'me' to create it in your own mailbox."
    },
    "hexColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hex Color",
      "examples": [
        "#ff0000",
        "#00ff00"
      ],
      "description": "An optional hexadecimal color code for the calendar in the format '#RRGGBB'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Hex Color",
      "human_parameter_description": "A custom color for the calendar using a hex code like #ff0000. Use this when you want a specific color instead of a preset option."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a new calendar in the user's mailbox."
}

      "title": "RecurrencePattern",
      "required": [
        "type",
        "interval"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Type",
          "description": "The recurrence pattern type: daily, weekly, absoluteMonthly, relativeMonthly, absoluteYearly, relativeYearly."
        },
        "index": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Index",
          "description": "Specifies on which instance of the allowed days specified in daysOfWeek the event occurs, counted from the first instance in the month. The possible values are: first, second, third, fourth, last. Default is first. Optional and used if type is relativeMonthly or relativeYearly."
        },
        "month": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Month",
          "description": "The month in which the event occurs. This is a number from 1 to 12."
        },
        "interval": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Interval",
          "description": "The number of units between occurrences, where units can be in days, weeks, months, or years, depending on the type."
        },
        "dayOfMonth": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Day Of Month",
          "description": "The day of the month on which the event occurs. Required if type is absoluteMonthly or absoluteYearly."
        },
        "daysOfWeek": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Days Of Week",
          "description": "A collection of the days of the week on which the event occurs. The possible values are: sunday, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday. If type is relativeMonthly or relativeYearly, and daysOfWeek specifies morethan one day, the event falls on the first day that satisfies the pattern. Required if type is weekly, relativeMonthly, or relativeYearly."
        },
        "firstDayOfWeek": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "First Day Of Week",
          "description": "The first day of the week. The possible values are: sunday, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday. Default is sunday. Required if type is weekly."
        }
      },
      "description": "The frequency of a recurring event."
    },
    "PatternedRecurrence": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PatternedRecurrence",
      "properties": {
        "range": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Range",
          "required": [
            "type",
            "startDate"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Type",
              "description": "The recurrence range. The possible values are: endDate, noEnd, numbered."
            },
            "endDate": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "End Date",
              "description": "The date to stop applying the recurrence pattern. Depending on the recurrence pattern of the event, the last occurrence of the meeting may not be this date. Required if type is endDate."
            },
            "startDate": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Start Date",
              "description": "The date to start applying the recurrence pattern. The first occurrence of the meeting may be this date or later, depending on the recurrence pattern of the event. Must be the same value as the start property of the recurring event."
            },
            "recurrenceTimeZone": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Recurrence Time Zone",
              "description": "Time zone for the startDate and endDate properties. Optional. If not specified, the time zone of the event is used."
            },
            "numberOfOccurrences": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Number Of Occurrences",
              "description": "The number of times to repeat the event. Required and must be positive if type is numbered."
            }
          },
          "description": "The duration of an event."
        },
        "pattern": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Pattern",
          "required": [
            "type",
            "interval"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Type",
              "description": "The recurrence pattern type: daily, weekly, absoluteMonthly, relativeMonthly, absoluteYearly, relativeYearly."

            "index": {
              "type": "string",

              "description": "Specifies on which instance of the allowed days specified in daysOfWeek the event occurs, counted from the first instance in the month. The possible values are: first, second, third, fourth, last. Default is first. Optional and used if type is relativeMonthly or relativeYearly."
            },
            "month": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Month",
              "description": "The month in which the event occurs. This is a number from 1 to 12."
            },
            "interval": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Interval",
              "description": "The number of units between occurrences, where units can be in days, weeks, months, or years, depending on the type."
            },
            "dayOfMonth": {
              "type": "integer",
              "title": "Day Of Month",
              "description": "The day of the month on which the event occurs. Required if type is absoluteMonthly or absoluteYearly."
            },
            "daysOfWeek": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Days Of Week",
              "description": "A collection of the days of the week on which the event occurs. The possible values are: sunday, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday. If type is relativeMonthly or relativeYearly, and daysOfWeek specifies morethan one day, the event falls on the first day that satisfies the pattern. Required if type is weekly, relativeMonthly, or relativeYearly."
            },
            "firstDayOfWeek": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "First Day Of Week",
              "description": "The first day of the week. The possible values are: sunday, monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday. Default is sunday. Required if type is weekly."
            }
          },
          "description": "The frequency of an event."
        }

      "description": "The recurrence pattern and range for an event."

                "type": "string"
              },
              "title": "Toll Free Numbers",
              "description": "The toll free numbers that can be used to join the conference."
            }
          },
          "description": "Details for an attendee to join the meeting online. Default is null. Read-only. After you set the isOnlineMeeting and onlineMeetingProvider properties to enable a meeting online, Microsoft Graph initializes onlineMeeting."
        },
        "originalStart": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Original Start",
          "description": "Represents the start time of an event when it is initially created as an occurrence or exception in a recurring series. This property is not returned for events that are single instances. Its date and time information is expressed in ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC."
        },
        "transactionId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Transaction Id",
          "description": "A custom identifier specified by a client app for the server to avoid redundant POST operations in case of client retries to create the same event."
        },
        "@odata.context": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "@Odata.Context",
          "description": "OData context URL for the response."
        },
        "hasAttachments": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Has Attachments",
          "description": "Set to true if the event has attachments."
        },
        "responseStatus": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Response Status",
          "properties": {
            "time": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Time",
              "description": "The date and time when the response was returned. It uses ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time."
            },
            "response": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Response",
              "description": "The response type. The possible values are: none, organizer, tentativelyAccepted, accepted, declined, notResponded."
            }
          },
          "description": "Indicates the type of response sent in reply to an event message."
        },
        "seriesMasterId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Series Master Id",
          "description": "The ID for the recurring series master item, if this event is part of a recurring series."
        },
        "createdDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Created Date Time",
          "description": "The timestamp when the event was created, in ISO 8601 format and always in UTC time."
        },
        "isOnlineMeeting": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Online Meeting",
          "description": "True if this event has online meeting information (that is, onlineMeeting points to an onlineMeetingInfo resource), false otherwise. Default is false."
        },
        "onlineMeetingUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Online Meeting Url",
          "description": "A URL for an online meeting. The property is set only when an organizer specifies in Outlook that an event is an online meeting. Read-only. Deprecated in favor of onlineMeeting property."
        },
        "responseRequested": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Response Requested",
          "description": "Default is true, which represents the organizer would like an invitee to send a response to the event."
        },
        "originalEndTimeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Original End Time Zone",
          "description": "The end time zone that was set when the event was created. A value of tzone://Microsoft/Custom indicates that a legacy custom time zone was set in desktop Outlook."
        },
        "cancelledOccurrences": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Cancelled Occurrences",
          "description": "Contains occurrenceId property values of canceled instances in a recurring series, if the event is the series master. Instances that are canceled are called canceledOccurrences."
        },
        "lastModifiedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Modified Date Time",
          "description": "The timestamp when the event was last modified, in ISO 8601 format and always in UTC time."
        },
        "allowNewTimeProposals": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Allow New Time Proposals",
          "description": "True if the meeting organizer allows invitees to propose a new time when responding; otherwise, false. Optional. Default is true."
        },
        "onlineMeetingProvider": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Online Meeting Provider",
          "description": "Represents the online meeting service provider. The possible values are unknown, teamsForBusiness, skypeForBusiness, skypeForConsumer."
        },
        "originalStartTimeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Original Start Time Zone",
          "description": "The start time zone that was set when the event was created. A value of tzone://Microsoft/Custom indicates that a legacy custom time zone was set in desktop Outlook."
        },
        "reminderMinutesBeforeStart": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Reminder Minutes Before Start",
          "description": "The number of minutes before the event start time that the reminder alert occurs."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_CALENDAR_EVENT_ATTACHMENT
Tool to create a new attachment for an event in a specific calendar. Use when you need to attach a file or item to an event within a particular calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCalendarEventAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id",
    "odata_type",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Item",
      "description": "The nested item payload; required when '@odata.type' is itemAttachment.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "meeting_notes.txt",
        "document.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the attachment."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA=",
        "AQMkADAwATM0MDAAMi04OTQ2LTllMjMtMDACLTAw..."
      ],
      "description": "The unique opaque identifier of the calendar event (NOT an email address). This is typically a long string starting with 'AAMkA' or 'AQMkA'. Obtain it from listing or searching calendar events."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "enum": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "@Odata.Type",
      "description": "Attachment type: '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' requires 'contentBytes'; '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' requires 'item'."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar. This is typically a long string identifying the specific calendar."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgYXR0YWNobWVudCBmb3IgdGhlIGV2ZW50Lg=="
      ],
      "description": "MUST be base64-encoded file contents (not plain text); required when '@odata.type' is fileAttachment. Raw/plain text must be base64-encoded first."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an attachment on an event in a specific Outlook calendar."
}

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_CALENDAR_EVENT_ATTACHMENT_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to create an upload session for large calendar event attachments in a specific calendar. Use when attaching files larger than 3 MB to Outlook calendar events in a specific calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCalendarEventAttachmentUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id",
    "attachmentItem"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com",
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID (GUID) or user principal name (email) whose calendar contains the event. Required for S2S (app-only) authentication. If not provided, uses the authenticated user context (/me endpoint)."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNMwAAAA==",
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar event to attach the file to. Obtain from listing or searching calendar events."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA=",
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar containing the event. Obtain from listing calendars."
    },
    "attachmentItem": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Attachment Item",
      "required": [
        "attachmentType",
        "name",
        "size"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "presentation.pptx",
            "meeting_notes.docx"
          ],
          "description": "Display name of the attachment file (e.g., 'presentation.pdf', 'agenda.docx')."
        },
        "size": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Size",
          "minimum": 1,
          "examples": [
            5242880,
            10485760
          ],
          "description": "Size of the attachment in bytes. For large files (>3 MB), use upload sessions."
        },
        "isInline": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Inline",
          "description": "Set to true if the attachment should be inline (embedded in event body)."
        },
        "contentId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Id",
          "description": "Content-ID (CID) for inline attachments, used to reference the attachment in HTML body."
        },
        "attachmentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "file",
          "title": "Attachment Type",
          "examples": [
            "file"
          ],
          "description": "Type of the attachment; must be 'file' for event attachment upload sessions."
        }
      },
      "description": "AttachmentItem object specifying the type, name, and size of the attachment to upload.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an upload session for a calendar event attachment in a specific calendar."
}

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_CALENDAR_EVENT_IN_CALENDAR
Tool to create a new event in a specific calendar for a user. Use when you need to create events in a specific calendar (e.g., shared or secondary calendars).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCalendarEventInCalendarRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "calendar_id",
    "subject",
    "start",
    "end"
  ],

      "type": "object",
      "title": "End",

        "timeZone"
      ],
      "properties": {

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2024-03-15T10:00:00",
            "2025-01-20T14:30:00"
          ],

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Zone",
          "examples": [
            "UTC",
            "America/New_York",
            "Pacific Standard Time"
          ],
          "description": "The time zone for the dateTime. Uses IANA time zone names (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York') or Windows time zone names (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time')."
        }
      },
      "description": "The end date, time, and time zone of the event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

      "type": "object",
      "title": "EventBody",
      "required": [
        "contentType",

      ],

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "Text",
            "HTML"
          ],
          "description": "The format of the event body. Must be 'Text' for plain text or 'HTML' for HTML content."
        }
      },
      "description": "The body content of an event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Start",
      "required": [
        "dateTime",
        "timeZone"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2024-03-15T10:00:00",
            "2025-01-20T14:30:00"
          ],
          "description": "A single point of time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-03-15T10:00:00)."
        },
        "timeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Zone",
          "examples": [
            "UTC",
            "America/New_York",
            "Pacific Standard Time"
          ],
          "description": "The time zone for the dateTime. Uses IANA time zone names (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York') or Windows time zone names (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time')."
        }
      },
      "description": "The start date, time, and time zone of the event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Team Sync Meeting",
        "Project Deadline"
      ],
      "description": "The subject/title of the event."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The user identifier for the calendar owner. Must be either 'me' (for the authenticated user), a Microsoft 365 User Principal Name (e.g., user@contoso.com), or an Azure AD object ID (GUID)."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "EventLocation",
      "required": [

          ],
          "description": "The name of the location where the event will take place."
        }
      },
      "description": "Location information for an event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },

      "type": "array",

}

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_CALENDAR_GROUP_CALENDAR_EVENT_ATTACHMENT
Tool to create a new attachment for an event in a calendar within a calendar group for a specific user. Use when you need to attach a file or item to an event in a user's calendar group.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCalendarGroupCalendarEventAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_group_id",
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id",
    "odata_type",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Item",
      "description": "The nested item payload; required when '@odata.type' is itemAttachment.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test-document.txt",
        "meeting_agenda.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the attachment."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "48d31887-5fad-4d73-a9f5-3c356e68a038"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Can use 'me' as shortcut for authenticated user."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA=",
        "AQMkADAwATM0MDAAMi04OTQ2LTllMjMtMDACLTAw..."
      ],
      "description": "The unique opaque identifier of the calendar event (NOT an email address). This is typically a long string starting with 'AAMkA' or 'AQMkA'. Obtain it from listing or searching calendar events."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "enum": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "@Odata.Type",
      "description": "Attachment type: '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' requires 'contentBytes'; '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' requires 'item'."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar within the calendar group."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgZmlsZSBmb3IgZXZlbnQgYXR0YWNobWVudA=="
      ],
      "description": "MUST be base64-encoded file contents (not plain text); required when '@odata.type' is fileAttachment. Raw/plain text must be base64-encoded first."
    },
    "calendar_group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHOwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar group containing the target calendar."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an attachment on a calendar event within a calendar group for a specific user."
}

{

Options: none (no access), freeBusyRead (view availability only), limitedRead (view availability and titles), read (view all event details), write (view and edit events), delegateWithoutPrivateEventAccess (delegate access excluding private events), delegateWithPrivateEventAccess (full delegate access including private events), custom (custom permissions)."

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_CONTACT_FOLDER
Tool to create a new contact folder in the user's mailbox. Use when needing to organize contacts into custom folders.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateContactFolderRequest",
  "example": {
    "displayName": "Friends",
    "parentFolderId": "AAMkAGI2T...ZlJS"
  },
  "required": [
    "displayName"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The user's principal name or object ID. Use 'me' for the authenticated user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or ID of the mailbox where you want to create the contact folder. Use 'me' to target your own account."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Friends"
      ],

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_DRAFT
Creates a new Outlook email draft with subject, body, recipients, and an optional attachment. This action creates a standalone draft for new conversations. To create a draft reply to an existing conversation/message, use the OUTLOOK_CREATE_DRAFT_REPLY action instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateEmailDraftRequest",
  "required": [

    "body"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "body": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Body",
      "examples": [

          "janedoe@example.com"

      ],

    }
  }

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_DRAFT_REPLY
Creates a draft reply in the specified user's Outlook mailbox to an existing message (identified by a valid `message_id`), optionally including a `comment` and CC/BCC recipients.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateDraftReplyRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Thank you for your email. I'll review and respond shortly."
      ],
      "description": "Plain text comment to include in the body of the reply draft.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Comment",
      "human_parameter_description": "A short note to include at the top of your reply draft. Leave this blank if you don't want to add a message."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "john.doe@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's mailbox identifier (email or 'me') for the original message and new draft location.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the mailbox where you want to create the draft reply. Use 'me' to use your own mailbox."
    },
    "cc_emails": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Cc Emails",
      "default": [],
      "examples": [
        [
          "jane.doe@example.com",
          "other@example.com"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of email addresses to add as CC recipients to the draft reply.",
      "human_parameter_name": "CC Emails",
      "human_parameter_description": "People you want to keep in the loop on the reply. Add one or more email addresses to include them as visible recipients."
    },
    "bcc_emails": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Bcc Emails",
      "default": [],
      "examples": [
        [
          "manager@example.com",
          "supervisor@example.com"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of email addresses to add as BCC recipients to the draft reply.",
      "human_parameter_name": "BCC Emails",
      "human_parameter_description": "People you want to copy privately on the reply. Add one or more email addresses; other recipients won\u2019t see these addresses."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Required. Unique ID of the message to reply to. Obtain this from actions like 'List Messages', 'Get Message', or 'Search Messages'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Message ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Required. The unique identifier of the email you want to reply to. You can get this from a previous message search, list, or get action."
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_EVENT_ATTACHMENT
Tool to create a new attachment for a user's calendar event. Use when you need to attach a file or item to an existing event in a specific user's calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateEventAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "event_id",
    "odata_type",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Item",
      "description": "The nested item payload; required when '@odata.type' is '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment'.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test-attachment.txt",
        "document.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the attachment."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "testcompud@outlook.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user's email address or user ID. Use 'me' for the authenticated user or provide the user's email address."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA=",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNPQAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique opaque identifier of the calendar event. This is typically a long string starting with 'AAMkA' or 'AQMkA'. Obtain it from listing or searching calendar events."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "enum": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "@Odata.Type",
      "description": "Attachment type: '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' requires 'contentBytes'; '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' requires 'item'."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgYXR0YWNobWVudCBmb3IgdGhlIGV2ZW50Lg=="
      ],
      "description": "MUST be base64-encoded file contents (not plain text); required when '@odata.type' is '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment'. Raw/plain text must be base64-encoded first."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an attachment on an Outlook calendar event for a specific user."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_EVENT_ATTACHMENT_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to create an upload session for large calendar event attachments. Use when attaching files larger than 3 MB to Outlook calendar events.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateEventAttachmentUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "event_id",
    "attachmentItem"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User ID or user principal name; use 'me' for the authenticated user."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAM3WypQAAAA==",
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar event to attach the file to. Obtain from listing or searching calendar events."
    },
    "attachmentItem": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Attachment Item",
      "required": [
        "attachmentType",
        "name",
        "size"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "test_document.pdf",
            "meeting_notes.docx"
          ],
          "description": "Display name of the attachment file (e.g., 'presentation.pdf', 'agenda.docx')."
        },
        "size": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Size",
          "minimum": 1,
          "examples": [
            5242880,

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_FORWARD_DRAFT
Tool to create a forward draft of an Outlook message for a specific user. Use when you need to prepare a forward email that can be edited before sending. The draft is created in the Drafts folder with the FW: prefix in the subject line.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateForwardDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Please review and let me know your thoughts.",
        "FYI - see below"
      ],
      "description": "Optional comment to include in the body of the forward draft. This text appears before the original message content."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "AdeleV@contoso.onmicrosoft.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's email address, UPN, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user. Use 'me' to access your own mailbox or specify another user's email address."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0leJgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to create a forward draft for. This is a base64-encoded string typically starting with 'AAMk' or 'AQMk'. Obtain this from list messages, get message, or search messages actions. Do NOT use email addresses or conversation IDs."
    },
    "toRecipients": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "To Recipients",
      "examples": [
        [
          "alice@example.com",
          "bob@example.com"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Optional list of email addresses to set as recipients for the forward draft. Recipients can be added or modified later by updating the draft before sending."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID or well-known name of the mail folder containing the message. Valid well-known names: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems', 'junkemail', 'archive', 'outbox', 'clutter', 'conflicts', 'conversationhistory', 'localfailures', 'msgfolderroot', 'recoverableitemsdeletions', 'scheduled', 'searchfolders', 'serverfailures', 'syncissues'. For other folders, use the base64-encoded folder ID obtained from list mail folders actions."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a forward draft of a message in a mail folder for a specific user."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_MAIL_FOLDER
Tool to create a new mail folder. Use when you need to organize email into a new folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMailFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "displayName"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier for the user whose mailbox the folder will be created in. Use 'me' for the authenticated user or provide the user's principal name or ID.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user whose mailbox you want to create the folder in. Use 'me' to create it in your own mailbox."
    },
    "isHidden": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Hidden",
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "Indicates whether the new folder is hidden. Default is false. Once set, this property cannot be updated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is Hidden",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether the new folder should be hidden from your usual folder list. Use this if you want the folder out of sight for a cleaner mailbox."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Clutter",
        "ProjectX"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the new mail folder.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name you want to give the new mail folder. Pick a clear, descriptive title so you can easily find it later."
    },
    "return_existing_if_exists": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Return Existing If Exists",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        true
      ],
      "description": "If true and a folder with the same name already exists, return the existing folder instead of raising an error. This makes the operation idempotent.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Return Existing If Exists",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enable this to make folder creation idempotent. If a folder with the same name already exists, the existing folder will be returned instead of an error."
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the request schema for creating a new mail folder in the user's mailbox."
}

**Input schema:**

        "user@domain.com"

    },

        "s3key"

        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"

          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "File to attach to the email. Either provide this field OR use 'content_bytes'. Cannot be used together with 'content_bytes'.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Unique Microsoft Graph message ID (opaque string like 'AAMkAGI2TAAA='). NOT an email address - this is an internal identifier returned by Microsoft Graph API operations."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Odata Type",
      "default": "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
      "examples": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment"
      ],
      "description": "The OData type of the attachment. Required by Microsoft Graph API. Use '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' for file attachments, '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' for embedded items (messages, events, contacts)."
    },
    "contentType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Type",
      "examples": [
        "application/pdf"
      ],
      "description": "MIME type of the attachment (e.g., 'application/pdf'). Required when using content_bytes. When using the attachment field, the mimetype is automatically inferred."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "SGVsbG8gd29ybGQh"
      ],
      "description": "Base64-encoded content of the file attachment (max size 3 MB). Either provide this field OR use the 'attachment' field (recommended). Cannot be used together with 'attachment'."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "AAMkAGI0ZjExAAA=",
        "sentitems"
      ],
      "description": "The ID or well-known name of the mail folder containing the message. ONLY these specific well-known names are valid as string names: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems', 'junkemail', 'archive', 'outbox', 'clutter', 'conflicts', 'conversationhistory', 'localfailures', 'msgfolderroot', 'recoverableitemsdeletions', 'scheduled', 'searchfolders', 'serverfailures', 'syncissues'. Arbitrary folder names are NOT valid. If the folder is not one of these well-known names, you MUST use the actual folder ID - a base64-encoded string (e.g., 'AAMkAGI0ZjExAAA=') obtained from list mail folders operations."
    },
    "contentLocation": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Location",
      "description": "URL location or path for reference attachments."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model to add an attachment to a specific message in a mail folder."
}

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_MAIL_FOLDER_MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to create an upload session for large (>3 MB) message attachments in a specific mail folder. Use when you need to upload attachments in chunks to a message located in a mail folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMailFolderMessageAttachmentUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id",
    "attachmentItem"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User ID or user principal name; use 'me' for the signed-in user."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ8AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0lxywAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to attach to."
    },
    "attachmentItem": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Attachment Item",
      "required": [
        "attachmentType",
        "name",
        "size"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "large_report.pdf",
            "test_document.pdf"
          ],
          "description": "Display name of the attachment (e.g., 'report.pdf')."
        },
        "size": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Size",
          "minimum": 3145728,
          "examples": [
            5242880
          ],
          "description": "Size of the attachment in bytes; must be at least 3 MB (3,145,728 bytes)."
        },
        "isInline": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Inline",
          "description": "Whether the attachment is inline in the message body."
        },
        "contentId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Id",
          "description": "Content-ID for inline attachments, referenced in HTML body if isInline is true."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf"
          ],
          "description": "MIME type of the attachment (e.g., 'application/pdf')."
        },
        "attachmentType": {
          "enum": [
            "file",
            "item",
            "reference"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Attachment Type",
          "examples": [
            "file"
          ],
          "description": "Type of the attachment; set to 'file' for file uploads."
        }
      },
      "description": "AttachmentItem object describing the attachment in the upload session.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ8AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the mail folder containing the message."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an Outlook attachment upload session for a message in a specific mail folder."
}
