## OUTLOOK_CREATE_MAIL_FOLDER_MESSAGE_RULE
Tool to create a message rule in a user's mail folder. Use when automating message processing with filters and actions.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMailFolderMessageRuleRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "displayName",
    "sequence",
    "actions"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "actions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Actions",
      "properties": {
        "delete": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Delete",
          "description": "Whether to delete matching messages."
        },
        "forwardTo": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Forward To",
          "examples": [
            [
              "assistant@company.com"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of email addresses to forward matching messages to."
        },
        "markAsRead": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Mark As Read",
          "description": "Whether to mark matching messages as read."
        },
        "copyToFolder": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Copy To Folder",
          "examples": [
            "AAMkAGI2NGNjOTExLTg0Y2ItNGIzYi05Y2Q0LWEwY2I4YWI1N2I4MQAuAAAAAACzMsPHYH6HQoSwfdpDx-2bAQCiGq-PkzMrQqW_3OC5Q5fDAAABBjsWAAA="
          ],
          "description": "Folder ID to copy matching messages to."
        },
        "moveToFolder": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Move To Folder",
          "examples": [
            "AAMkAGI2NGNjOTExLTg0Y2ItNGIzYi05Y2Q0LWEwY2I4YWI1N2I4MQAuAAAAAACzMsPHYH6HQoSwfdpDx-2bAQCiGq-PkzMrQqW_3OC5Q5fDAAABBjsWAAA="
          ],
          "description": "Folder ID to move matching messages to."
        },
        "assignCategories": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Assign Categories",
          "examples": [
            [
              "Important",
              "Work"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of categories to assign to matching messages."
        },
        "stopProcessingRules": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Stop Processing Rules",
          "examples": [
            true,
            false
          ],
          "description": "If true, stops processing other rules after this rule's actions execute. Useful for priority rules where you want to prevent lower-priority rules from running. Example: High-priority sender rule that moves to VIP folder and stops other filing rules."
        }
      },
      "description": "Actions to take when the rule conditions are met.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-g7h8-i9j0-k1l2m3n4o5p6"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Can use 'me' shortcut for /me/ path or actual user ID for /users/{user_id}/ path."
    },
    "sequence": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Sequence",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        5
      ],
      "description": "Order in which the rule is executed (lower numbers execute first, minimum value is 1)."
    },
    "isEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Enabled",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Whether the rule is enabled."
    },
    "conditions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MessageRulePredicatesRequest",
      "properties": {
        "importance": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Importance",
          "examples": [
            "high",
            "normal",
            "low"
          ],
          "description": "Message importance level to match (low, normal, high)."
        },
        "bodyContains": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Body Contains",
          "examples": [
            [
              "urgent",
              "important"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of strings that the message body must contain."
        },
        "fromAddresses": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "From Addresses",
          "examples": [
            [
              "boss@company.com",
              "client@external.com"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of exact sender email addresses to match (e.g., 'boss@company.com'). For partial/domain matching, use senderContains instead."
        },
        "hasAttachments": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Has Attachments",
          "description": "Whether the message must have attachments."
        },
        "senderContains": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Sender Contains",
          "examples": [
            [
              "noreply",
              "no-reply",
              "donotreply"
            ],
            [
              "@github.com",
              "@linkedin.com"
            ],
            [
              "notifications",
              "alerts",
              "automated"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of strings for partial sender email matching. If sender email contains ANY of these strings, rule triggers. Useful for domain matching (e.g., '@openai.com') or pattern matching (e.g., 'noreply', 'no-reply', 'notifications'). More flexible than fromAddresses which requires exact matches."
        },
        "subjectContains": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Subject Contains",
          "examples": [
            [
              "meeting",
              "project"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of strings that the message subject must contain."
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_CALENDAR_EVENT_EXTENSION
Tool to create a new open extension on a calendar event for a specific user. Use when you need to store custom data with an event.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeCalendarEventExtensionRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id",
    "extension_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "6640adbb5cb743b0"
      ],
      "description": "The user identifier for the calendar owner. Must be either 'me' (for the authenticated user), a Microsoft 365 User Principal Name (e.g., user@contoso.com), or an Azure AD object ID (GUID)."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNQAAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar event to add the extension to."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar containing the event."
    },
    "extension_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Name",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Com.Contoso.CustomData"
      ],
      "description": "The unique name for the extension. Must follow the format 'Com.Company.ExtensionName' (e.g., Com.Contoso.TestExtension)."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "customDate": "2026-02-23T00:00:00.000Z",
          "customField1": "Test value",
          "customField2": 12345
        },
        {
          "notes": "Important event",
          "status": "active",
          "priority": 1
        }
      ],
      "description": "Custom properties to store in the extension as key-value pairs. Each property can be a string, number, or boolean value.",

        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_CALENDAR_PERMISSION
Tool to create a new calendar permission for a specific user's calendar. Use when you need to share another user's calendar with someone or grant access with specific permission levels.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeCalendarPermissionRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "calendar_id",
    "emailAddress",
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "freeBusyRead",
        "limitedRead",
        "read",
        "write"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "examples": [
        "read",
        "write"
      ],
      "description": "The permission role to grant. freeBusyRead: view free/busy status only. limitedRead: view free/busy status, titles and locations. read: view all details except private events. write: view all details except private events and edit events."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "6640adbb5cb743b0",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user whose calendar permissions will be modified. Cannot use 'me' shortcut - must be actual user ID or userPrincipalName."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA=",
        "AAMkADcLjUyMQUtZTFlOC00NzU0LTk3ZWMtZTA3NGQ4ZWI1N2YyAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar to which permissions will be added."
    },
    "isRemovable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Removable",
      "description": "Whether the permission can be removed in the future. If set to true, the recipient can later be removed from the calendar permissions. Optional parameter."
    },
    "emailAddress": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "address"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "Test User",
            "John Doe"
          ],
          "description": "The display name of the person or entity to grant permission to."
        },
        "address": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Address",
          "examples": [
            "testuser@example.com",
            "john.doe@company.com"
          ],
          "description": "The email address of the person or entity to grant permission to."
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_CHILD_FOLDER_MESSAGE
Tool to create a new draft message in a child folder within a user's mail folder. Use when creating messages in nested folder structures for a specific user's mailbox.

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_CONTACT_FOLDERS_CONTACTS
Tool to create a new contact in a specific user's contact folder. Use when you need to add a contact to a particular folder for a specified user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeContactFoldersContactsRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "contact_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notes",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Met at the 2023 Tech Conference."
      ],
      "description": "Personal notes about the contact. These notes are stored as 'personalNotes' in the Outlook contact details."
    },
    "surname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Surname",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Doe"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's surname (last name)."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "6640adbb5cb743b0",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user whose contact folder will be modified. Can be the user's object ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (e.g., 'user@contoso.com')."
    },
    "birthday": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Birthday",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "1990-01-01"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's birthday in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The time component will be set to midnight UTC (e.g., '1990-01-01' becomes '1990-01-01T00:00:00Z' in the API request)."
    },
    "jobTitle": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Job Title",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Software Engineer"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's job title."
    },
    "givenName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Given Name",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "John"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's given (first) name."
    },
    "homePhone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Home Phone",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "+1 555 555 5557"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's home phone number. If provided, this will be stored in Outlook as a list containing this single number."
    },
    "categories": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Categories",
      "examples": [
        "Friend",
        "Colleague"
      ],
      "description": "A list of categories to assign to the contact."
    },
    "department": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Department",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Engineering"
      ],
      "description": "The department the contact belongs to within their company."
    },
    "companyName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Company Name",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Example Corp"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the company the contact is associated with."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "John Doe"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's display name, typically their full name."
    },
    "mobilePhone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mobile Phone",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "+1 555 555 5556"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's mobile phone number."
    },
    "businessPhones": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Business Phones",
      "examples": [
        "+1 234 567 8900"
      ],
      "description": "A list of business phone numbers for the contact. Each number should be a string."
    },
    "emailAddresses": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "EmailAddress",
        "required": [
          "address"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "default": "",
            "examples": [
              "Jane Doe"
            ],
            "description": "The display name for the contact's email address."
          },
          "address": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Address",
            "examples": [
              "jane.doe@example.com"
            ],
            "description": "The contact's email address."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Email Addresses",
      "description": "A list of email addresses for the contact."
    },
    "officeLocation": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Office Location",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Building 1, Room 101"
      ],
      "description": "The contact's office location."
    },
    "contact_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mZNQAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "Identifier of the contact folder where the new contact will be created. Must be a valid contact folder ID obtained from 'Get Contact Folders' or 'List Contact Folders'."
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_EVENT
Tool to create a new calendar event for a specific user. Use when you need to create events in a user's calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeEventRequest",
  "required": [
    "subject",
    "start",
    "end"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "end": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "End",
      "required": [
        "dateTime",
        "timeZone"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2024-03-15T10:00:00",
            "2025-01-20T14:30:00"
          ],
          "description": "A single point of time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-03-15T10:00:00)."
        },
        "timeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Zone",
          "examples": [
            "UTC",
            "America/New_York",
            "Pacific Standard Time"
          ],
          "description": "The time zone for the dateTime. Uses IANA time zone names (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York') or Windows time zone names (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time')."
        }
      },
      "description": "The end date, time, and time zone of the event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "body": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "EventBody",
      "required": [
        "contentType",
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "examples": [
            "This is a team meeting to discuss project updates."
          ],
          "description": "The actual content of the event body."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "Text",
            "HTML"
          ],
          "description": "The format of the event body. Must be 'Text' for plain text or 'HTML' for HTML content."
        }
      },
      "description": "The body content of an event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "start": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Start",
      "required": [
        "dateTime",
        "timeZone"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2024-03-15T10:00:00",
            "2025-01-20T14:30:00"
          ],
          "description": "A single point of time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-03-15T10:00:00)."
        },
        "timeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Zone",
          "examples": [
            "UTC",
            "America/New_York",
            "Pacific Standard Time"
          ],
          "description": "The time zone for the dateTime. Uses IANA time zone names (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York') or Windows time zone names (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time')."
        }
      },
      "description": "The start date, time, and time zone of the event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Team Sync Meeting",
        "Project Deadline"
      ],
      "description": "The subject/title of the event."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The user identifier for the calendar owner. Must be either 'me' (for the authenticated user), a Microsoft 365 User Principal Name (e.g., user@contoso.com), or an Azure AD object ID (GUID)."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "EventLocation",
      "required": [
        "displayName"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "displayName": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Display Name",
          "examples": [
            "Conference Room A",
            "Building 2, Room 301"
          ],
          "description": "The name of the location where the event will take place."
        }
      },
      "description": "Location information for an event.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "attendees": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Attendee",
        "required": [
          "emailAddress"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "default": "required",
            "examples": [
              "required",
              "optional",
              "resource"
            ],
            "description": "The type of attendee. Valid values are 'required', 'optional', and 'resource'."
          },
          "emailAddress": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Email Address",
            "required": [
              "address"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Name",
                "examples": [
                  "John Doe"
                ],
                "description": "The display name of the attendee."
              },
              "address": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Address",
                "examples": [
                  "john.doe@example.com"
                ],
                "description": "The email address of the attendee."
              }
            },
            "description": "The email address and optional name of the attendee.",
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        "description": "Event attendee information."
      },
      "title": "Attendees",
      "description": "A list of attendees for the event. Optional - events can be created without attendees."
    },
    "isOnlineMeeting": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Online Meeting",
      "description": "True to indicate that the event is an online meeting. This will automatically generate an online meeting link if onlineMeetingProvider is set."
    },
    "allowNewTimeProposals": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow New Time Proposals",
      "description": "True if the meeting organizer allows invitees to propose a new time when responding. Default is true."
    },
    "onlineMeetingProvider": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Online Meeting Provider",
      "examples": [
        "teamsForBusiness"
      ],
      "description": "The online meeting provider. Currently, only 'teamsForBusiness' is supported."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a new event in a specific user's calendar."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_EVENT_ATTACHMENT_UPLOAD_SESSION
Tool to create an upload session for large event attachments. Use when attaching files larger than 3 MB to the authenticated user's Outlook events.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeEventAttachmentUploadSessionRequest",
  "required": [
    "event_id",
    "attachmentItem"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID (GUID) or user principal name (email) to create the upload session for. Required for S2S (app-only) authentication. If not provided, uses the authenticated user context (/me endpoint)."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNOAAAAA==",
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the event to attach the file to. Obtain from listing or searching events."
    },
    "attachmentItem": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Attachment Item",
      "required": [
        "attachmentType",
        "name",
        "size"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "test-document.pdf",
            "meeting-notes.docx"
          ],
          "description": "Display name of the attachment file (e.g., 'presentation.pdf', 'report.docx')."
        },
        "size": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Size",
          "minimum": 1,
          "examples": [
            3483322,
            5242880
          ],
          "description": "Size of the attachment in bytes. For large files (>3 MB), use upload sessions."
        },
        "isInline": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Inline",
          "description": "Set to true if the attachment should be inline (embedded in event body)."
        },
        "contentId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Id",
          "description": "Content-ID (CID) for inline attachments, used to reference the attachment in HTML body."
        },
        "attachmentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "file",
          "title": "Attachment Type",
          "examples": [
            "file"
          ],
          "description": "Type of the attachment; must be 'file' for event attachment upload sessions."
        }
      },
      "description": "AttachmentItem object specifying the type, name, and size of the attachment to upload.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an upload session for an authenticated user's event attachment."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {

        "expirationDateTime",

        "nextExpectedRanges": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Next Expected Ranges",

        }
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_FORWARD_DRAFT
Tool to create a draft forward of an existing message. Use when you need to prepare a forward that can be edited before sending. The draft can be updated with recipients and additional content before being sent.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeForwardDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "FYI - please review this email."
      ],
      "description": "Optional comment to include in the body of the forward draft."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "john.doe@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's mailbox identifier (email or 'me') for the original message and new draft location."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Required. Unique ID of the message to forward. Obtain this from actions like 'List Messages', 'Get Message', or 'Search Messages'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a forward draft of an Outlook message."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_INFERENCE_CLASSIFICATION_OVERRIDE
Tool to create a Focused Inbox override for a sender identified by SMTP address for a specific user. Use when you need to configure messages from a specific sender to always be classified as focused or other for a particular user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeInferenceClassificationOverrideRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "classifyAs",
    "senderEmailAddress"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "user@contoso.com",
        "87d349ed-44d7-43e1-9a83-5f2406dee5bd"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Can be user ID (GUID) or user principal name (UPN)."
    },
    "classifyAs": {
      "enum": [
        "focused",
        "other"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Classify As",
      "examples": [
        "focused",
        "other"
      ],
      "description": "How messages from the specified sender should always be classified. Must be either 'focused' or 'other'."
    },
    "senderEmailAddress": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Sender Email Address",
      "required": [
        "address"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "Samantha Booth",
            "John Doe"
          ],
          "description": "The display name of the sender."
        },
        "address": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Address",
          "examples": [
            "samanthab@contoso.com",
            "john.doe@example.com"
          ],
          "description": "The SMTP address of the sender."
        }
      },
      "description": "Email address information for the sender to create the override for.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request model for creating a Focused Inbox override for a specific user."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CreateMeInferenceClassificationOverrideResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CreateMeInferenceClassificationOverrideResponse",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The unique identifier of the created override."
        },
        "classifyAs": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Classify As",
          "description": "How messages from the sender will be classified."
        },
        "senderEmailAddress": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "Sender Email Address",
          "description": "Email address information for the sender.",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Response model for creating a Focused Inbox override."
    }
  },
  "title": "CreateMeInferenceClassificationOverrideResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "description": "The unique identifier of the created override."
        },
        "classifyAs": {
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_MAIL_FOLDER_MESSAGE_REPLY_ALL_DRAFT
Deprecated: Use OUTLOOK_CREATE_REPLY_ALL_DRAFT instead, which supports both /me and /users/{user_id} endpoints with timezone support.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeMailFolderMessageReplyAllDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Thank you all for your feedback. I'll review and respond shortly."
      ],
      "description": "Optional plain text comment to include in the body of the reply-all draft."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f",
        "KaranVaidya@authkit.ai"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID or principal name (email) of the user to create a reply-all draft for. Required for app-only (S2S) authentication. Use either the GUID format (e.g., '43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f') or email format (e.g., 'user@domain.com'). If not provided, defaults to '/me' endpoint for delegated authentication."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_MESSAGE_REPLY_ALL_DRAFT
Tool to create a draft reply-all to a user's message. Use when you need to create a draft reply to the sender and all recipients of an email message in a user's mailbox.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeMessageReplyAllDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Thank you all for your feedback. I'll review and respond shortly."
      ],
      "description": "Optional plain text comment to include in the body of the reply-all draft."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "AdeleV@contoso.onmicrosoft.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's email address, user principal name (UPN), or 'me' for the currently authenticated user. Use 'me' to access your own mailbox or specify another user's email address."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0l9qQAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to create a reply-all draft for. This is a base64-encoded string typically starting with 'AAMk' or 'AQMk'. Obtain this from list messages, get message, or search messages actions. Do NOT use email addresses or conversation IDs."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a reply-all draft to a user's message."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_ME_REPLY_ALL_DRAFT
Tool to create a draft reply-all to a message in a child folder. Use when you need to create a draft reply to the sender and all recipients of a message located in a subfolder within a mail folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeReplyAllDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "child_folder_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Thank you all for your feedback. I'll review and respond shortly."
      ],
      "description": "Optional plain text comment to include in the body of the reply-all draft."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "AdeleV@contoso.onmicrosoft.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's email address, UPN, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user. Use 'me' to access your own mailbox or specify another user's email address."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAARTQwfgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to create a reply-all draft for. This is a base64-encoded string typically starting with 'AAMk' or 'AQMk'. Obtain this from list messages, get message, or search messages actions. Do NOT use email addresses or conversation IDs."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID or well-known name of the parent mail folder. Valid well-known names: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems', 'junkemail', 'archive', 'outbox', 'clutter', 'conflicts', 'conversationhistory', 'localfailures', 'msgfolderroot', 'recoverableitemsdeletions', 'scheduled', 'searchfolders', 'serverfailures', 'syncissues'. For other folders, use the base64-encoded folder ID obtained from list mail folders actions."
    },
    "child_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Child Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACARAAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the child folder (subfolder) within the parent mail folder. This is a base64-encoded folder ID obtained from list mail folders actions. Child folders are nested folders within a parent folder."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a reply-all draft to a message in a child folder."
}
```

```json
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to create a reply draft for. Must be a non-draft message. Typically a base64-encoded string obtained from list messages or search messages actions."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a reply draft for an Outlook message."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT
Tool to create an attachment for a message. Use when you need to attach a file or item to an existing message. Supports file attachments, item attachments, and reference attachments.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMessageAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_id",
    "odata_type",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ItemPayload",
      "properties": {
        "@odata.type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "@Odata.Type",
          "description": "Type of the attached item (e.g., #microsoft.graph.message)"
        }
      },
      "description": "Generic payload for item attachments. Accepts any additional fields.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test-attachment.txt",
        "document.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the attachment."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "User ID or userPrincipalName. Use 'me' for the authenticated user. For S2S connections, pass the specific user ID."
    },
    "isInline": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Inline",
      "description": "Set to true if the attachment should appear inline in the message body."
    },
    "contentId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Id",
      "description": "Content ID for inline attachments, used in HTML body references."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mZKAAAAMZNiu9q3Y9Ioi7whL2EyrIAAABTSdTiAAAA"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to add the attachment to."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "enum": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.referenceAttachment"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "@Odata.Type",
      "examples": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment"
      ],
      "description": "Type of attachment to create. Use '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' for files, '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' for embedded items, or '#microsoft.graph.referenceAttachment' for references."
    },
    "contentType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Type",
      "examples": [
        "text/plain",
        "application/pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The MIME type of the attachment (e.g., 'text/plain', 'application/pdf')."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgYXR0YWNobWVudCBmaWxlIGNvbnRlbnQu"
      ],
      "description": "Base64-encoded file contents. Required when '@odata.type' is fileAttachment. Must be valid base64."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_REPLY_ALL_DRAFT
Tool to create a reply-all draft for a message in a mail folder. Use when you need to create a draft reply to all recipients of an email.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateReplyAllDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Thank you for your email. I'll review and respond shortly."
      ],
      "description": "Plain text comment to include in the body of the reply-all draft."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "john.doe@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's mailbox identifier (email or 'me') for the original message and new draft location."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Required. Unique ID of the message to reply to. Obtain this from actions like 'List Messages', 'Get Message', or 'Search Messages'."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Required. The unique identifier of the mail folder containing the message to reply to. Obtain this from actions like 'List Mail Folders' or 'Get Mail Folder'."
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_TASK
Tool to create a new task in Microsoft To Do within a specified task list. Use when adding tasks with title, due dates, reminders, importance levels, descriptions, categories, and linked resources.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTaskRequest",
  "required": [
    "todo_task_list_id",
    "title"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "body": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ItemBody",
      "required": [
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "examples": [
            "Review project proposal and provide feedback"
          ],
          "description": "The content of the task body."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "default": "text",
          "examples": [
            "text",
            "html"
          ],
          "description": "The type of the content. Use 'text' for plain text or 'html' for HTML formatted content."
        }
      },
      "description": "Task body content with content type.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "examples": [
        "Review project proposal",
        "Schedule team meeting",
        "Complete quarterly report"
      ],
      "maxLength": 255,
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The title of the task. This is the main text displayed for the task."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "User ID or userPrincipalName. Use 'me' for the signed-in user (delegated auth) or a specific user ID for app-only (S2S) authentication."
    },
    "categories": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Categories",
      "examples": [
        [
          "Work",
          "Urgent"
        ],
        [
          "Personal",
          "Shopping"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of category labels to organize the task (e.g., tags for filtering or grouping tasks)."
    },
    "importance": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Importance",
      "default": "normal",
      "examples": [
        "low",
        "normal",
        "high"
      ],
      "description": "The importance level of the task. Must be one of: 'low', 'normal', or 'high'. Defaults to 'normal' if not specified."
    },
    "dueDateTime": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DateTimeTimeZone",
      "required": [
        "dateTime"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2024-01-15T14:30:00",
            "2024-12-25T09:00:00"
          ],
          "description": "A single point of time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-15T14:30:00). Do not include timezone offset in the string itself."
        },
        "timeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Zone",
          "default": "UTC",
          "examples": [
            "UTC",
            "America/New_York",
            "Europe/London",
            "Pacific Standard Time"
          ],
          "description": "Time zone designation. Use standard IANA time zone identifiers (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') or 'UTC' for Coordinated Universal Time."
        }
      },
      "description": "Date/time with timezone information for task due dates and reminders.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "linkedResources": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "LinkedResource",
        "properties": {
          "webUrl": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Web Url",
            "examples": [
              "https://example.com/document.pdf"
            ],
            "description": "URL pointing to the linked resource."
          },
          "displayName": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Display Name",
            "examples": [
              "Project Proposal.docx"
            ],
            "description": "The display name of the linked resource."
          },
          "applicationName": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Application Name",
            "examples": [
              "Microsoft Word",
              "OneNote"
            ],
            "description": "The application name of the source that created the linked resource."
          }
        },
        "description": "Resource linked to the task (e.g., document, email, or web link)."
      },
      "title": "Linked Resources",
      "description": "A list of resources (documents, links, emails) associated with the task. Each resource can have a webUrl, applicationName, and displayName."
    },
    "reminderDateTime": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "DateTimeTimeZone",
      "required": [
        "dateTime"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2024-01-15T14:30:00",

          ],
          "description": "A single point of time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-15T14:30:00). Do not include timezone offset in the string itself."
        },
        "timeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Zone",
          "default": "UTC",
          "examples": [
            "UTC",

            "Europe/London",
            "Pacific Standard Time"
          ],
          "description": "Time zone designation. Use standard IANA time zone identifiers (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') or 'UTC' for Coordinated Universal Time."
        }
      },
      "description": "Date/time with timezone information for task due dates and reminders.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "todo_task_list_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Todo Task List Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATM0MDAAMS1iNTcyLTI2M2MtMDACLTAwCgAuAAADeiYEq-w"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the task list where the task will be created. Use the List To Do task lists action to retrieve available list IDs."
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_CALENDAR_EVENT_ATTACHMENT
Tool to create a new attachment for an event in a specific user's calendar. Use when you need to attach a file or item to an event within a particular user's calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUserCalendarEventAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id",
    "odata_type",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Item",
      "description": "The nested item payload; required when '@odata.type' is itemAttachment.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test-document.txt",
        "meeting_notes.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the attachment."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "testcompud@outlook.com",
        "48d31887-5fad-4d73-a9f5-3c356e68a038"
      ],
      "description": "The user's ID or userPrincipalName (email address). This identifies the user whose calendar contains the event."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI1AAAt9AHjAAA=",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNQQAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique opaque identifier of the calendar event (NOT an email address). This is typically a long string starting with 'AAMkA' or 'AQMkA'. Obtain it from listing or searching calendar events."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "enum": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "@Odata.Type",
      "description": "Attachment type: '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' requires 'contentBytes'; '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' requires 'item'."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar containing the event. This is typically a long opaque string identifying the specific calendar."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgZG9jdW1lbnQgZm9yIGF0dGFjaG1lbnQu"
      ],
      "description": "MUST be base64-encoded file contents (not plain text); required when '@odata.type' is fileAttachment. Raw/plain text must be base64-encoded first."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an attachment on an event in a specific user's calendar."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_CALENDAR_GROUP_CALENDAR
Tool to create a new calendar in a calendar group for a specific user. Use when organizing events into a separate calendar within a specific calendar group for a user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUserCalendarGroupCalendarRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_group_id",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Marketing Calendar",
        "Project Plan Calendar",
        "Test Calendar Created by Curl"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the new calendar."
    },
    "color": {
      "enum": [
        "auto",
        "lightBlue",
        "lightGreen",
        "lightOrange",
        "lightGray",
        "lightYellow",
        "lightTeal",
        "lightPink",
        "lightBrown",
        "lightPurple",
        "lightRed"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Color",
      "description": "The theme color to assign to the calendar. Supported values: auto, lightBlue, lightGreen, lightOrange, lightGray, lightYellow, lightTeal, lightPink, lightBrown, lightPurple, lightRed."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "6640adbb5cb743b0"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the user (can also be userPrincipalName). Use 'me' for the authenticated user."
    },
    "calendar_group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHOwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the calendar group where the calendar will be created."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a new calendar in a calendar group for a specific user."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_CONTACTS_EXTENSIONS
Tool to create a new open extension on a specific user's contact. Use when you need to store custom data with a contact for a specific user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUserContactsExtensionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "contact_id",
    "extension_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "6640adbb5cb743b0",
        "user@contoso.com"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Can be the user's object ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (e.g., 'user@contoso.com')."
    },
    "contact_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ4AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0nIvgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the contact to add the extension to."
    },
    "extension_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Name",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Com.Contoso.CustomerInfo"
      ],
      "description": "The unique name for the extension. Must follow reverse DNS format (e.g., Com.Contoso.ExtensionName)."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "customNumber": 12345,
          "customProperty1": "Test Value 1",
          "customProperty2": "Test Value 2"
        },
        {
          "isActive": true,
          "priority": "high",
          "companyCode": "CONT123"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Custom properties to store in the extension as key-value pairs. Each property can be a string, number, or boolean value.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{

    }
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_EVENT_CALENDAR_PERMISSION
Tool to create a calendar permission via an event's calendar. Use when granting calendar access through an event by specifying the event ID and user email address.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUserEventCalendarPermissionRequest",
  "required": [
    "event_id",
    "emailAddress",
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "read",
        "write",
        "freeBusyRead",
        "limitedRead"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "examples": [
        "read",
        "write"
      ],
      "description": "The permission role to grant. Options: read (view all event details), write (view and edit events), freeBusyRead (view availability only), limitedRead (view availability and titles)."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID or principal name of the user. Use 'me' for the authenticated user."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNQwAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the event whose calendar will have the permission added."
    },
    "isRemovable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Removable",
      "description": "True if the permission can be removed by the user, false otherwise. Optional."
    },
    "emailAddress": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Email Address",
      "required": [
        "address"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "Test User",
            "John Doe"
          ],
          "description": "The display name of the person receiving the calendar permission."
        },
        "address": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Address",
          "examples": [
            "testuser@example.com",
            "john.doe@example.com"
          ],
          "description": "The email address of the person receiving the calendar permission."
        }
      },
      "description": "Email address object containing the name and address of the person receiving the permission.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "isInsideOrganization": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Inside Organization",
      "description": "True if the user is inside the same organization as the calendar owner, false otherwise. Optional."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a calendar permission via an event's calendar."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_MAIL_FOLDER_MESSAGE_REPLY_DRAFT
Tool to create a reply draft for a message in a user's mail folder. Use when you need to prepare a reply without sending it immediately. The draft is created in the Drafts folder and includes the RE: prefix in the subject line.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUserMailFolderMessageReplyDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Thank you for your email. I'll review and respond shortly."
      ],
      "description": "Optional plain text comment to include in the body of the reply draft."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "john.doe@example.com",
        "48d31887-5fad-4d73-a9f5-3c356e68a038"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Use 'me' for the authenticated user, or provide a specific user principal name (email address) or user ID."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0l9pgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to reply to. This is a base64-encoded string typically starting with 'AAMk' or 'AQMk'. Obtain this from list messages, get message, or search messages actions. Do NOT use email addresses or conversation IDs."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQkAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID or well-known name of the mail folder containing the message. Valid well-known names: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems', 'junkemail', 'archive', 'outbox', 'clutter', 'conflicts', 'conversationhistory', 'localfailures', 'msgfolderroot', 'recoverableitemsdeletions', 'scheduled', 'searchfolders', 'serverfailures', 'syncissues'. For other folders, use the base64-encoded folder ID obtained from list mail folders actions."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a reply draft to a message in a user's mail folder."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_MAIL_FOLDERS_CHILD_FOLDERS
Tool to create a new child folder under a specified mail folder for a user. Use when organizing email into nested folder hierarchies within a specific user's mailbox.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUserMailFoldersChildFoldersRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "mail_folder_id",
    "displayName"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "6640adbb5cb743b0",
        "user@example.com",
        "john.doe@contoso.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's ID or userPrincipalName. The unique identifier of the user whose mailbox will contain the new child folder."
    },
    "isHidden": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Hidden",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Indicates whether the new child folder should be hidden. Default is false. Once set during creation, this property cannot be updated later."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Test Child Folder",
        "ProjectX Archive",
        "Important Emails"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the new child folder. This is the name that will be visible to the user in their mail client."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "sentitems",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID or well-known name of the parent mail folder under which to create the child folder. Common well-known names include: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems', 'junkemail', 'archive', 'outbox', 'clutter', 'conflicts', 'conversationhistory', 'localfailures', 'msgfolderroot', 'recoverableitemsdeletions', 'scheduled', 'searchfolders', 'serverfailures', 'syncissues'. For folder IDs, obtain them from listing mail folders - they are base64-encoded strings (e.g., 'AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQwAAAA=')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a child folder under a specified mail folder for a user."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_MASTER_CATEGORY
Tool to create a new category in a user's master category list. Use when you need to add a category to organize email and calendar items for a specific user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",

  "required": [

      ],

      "examples": [
        "preset9"
      ],
      "description": "A pre-set color constant for the category. Allowed values: preset0 through preset24."

      "examples": [
```

## OUTLOOK_CREATE_USER_MESSAGE_ATTACHMENT
Tool to create an attachment on a message in a user's mail folder. Use when you need to attach a file or item to an existing message in a specific user's mailbox.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateUserMessageAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id",
    "odata_type",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "item": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Item",
      "description": "The nested item payload (message, event, or contact) with its own '@odata.type'. Required when '@odata.type' is '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment'.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "test-file.txt",
        "report.pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The display name of the attachment (e.g., file name like 'document.pdf' or 'image.png')."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "6640adbb5cb743b0",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Can be the user's UPN (user principal name) or the user's object ID."
    },
    "isInline": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Inline",
      "description": "Set to true if the attachment should appear inline within the message body content."
    },
    "contentId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Id",
      "description": "Content ID for inline attachments, used to reference the attachment within the HTML message body."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0leLgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to attach to. This is NOT an email address but an opaque string identifier returned by Microsoft Graph API operations."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "enum": [
        "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment",
        "#microsoft.graph.referenceAttachment"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "@Odata.Type",
      "description": "The OData type of the attachment. Use '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment' for file attachments (requires 'contentBytes'), '#microsoft.graph.itemAttachment' for embedded items like messages or events (requires 'item'), or '#microsoft.graph.referenceAttachment' for reference attachments (requires link and permission details)."
    },
    "contentType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Type",
      "examples": [
        "text/plain",
        "application/pdf"
      ],
      "description": "The MIME type of the attachment (e.g., 'text/plain', 'application/pdf'). Optional but recommended for file attachments."
    },
    "contentBytes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Bytes",
      "examples": [
        "VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3QgYXR0YWNobWVudA=="
      ],
      "description": "Base64-encoded content of the file attachment. Required when '@odata.type' is '#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment'. Must be valid base64-encoded data."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the mail folder containing the message. This is typically a long opaque string identifying the specific folder."
    },
    "contentLocation": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Location",
      "description": "URI indicating the content location of the attachment."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an attachment on a message in a user's mail folder."
}
```

```json
          ],
```

## OUTLOOK_DELETE_EVENT
DEPRECATED: Use OUTLOOK_DELETE_CALENDAR_EVENT instead. Tool to delete an event from the user's calendar. Use when removing calendar events. If this is a meeting, deleting it removes it from the organizer's calendar and sends a cancellation message to all attendees. Require explicit user confirmation before calling this action.

```json
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TG93AAA=",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNNQAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the event to delete. This ID can be obtained from list events or get event actions. For recurring events, verify whether this ID is the series master (deletes entire series) or a specific instance (deletes one occurrence). Obtain from OUTLOOK_LIST_EVENTS, OUTLOOK_GET_EVENT, or OUTLOOK_GET_CALENDAR_VIEW."

  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_DOWNLOAD_OUTLOOK_ATTACHMENT
Downloads a specific file attachment from an email message in a Microsoft Outlook mailbox; the attachment must contain 'contentBytes' (binary data) and not be a link or embedded item. The returned data.file.s3url is temporary — download the file immediately after calling this tool; call again to get a fresh URL if needed. High-volume parallel calls may trigger HTTP 429 responses; honor the Retry-After header and use exponential backoff.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "DownloadOutlookAttachmentRequest",
  "required": [
    "message_id",
    "attachment_id",
    "file_name"

      "type": "string",

      "default": "me",

      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user whose mailbox you want to access. Use 'me' to access your own mailbox."
    },
    "file_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "File Name",
      "examples": [
        "document.pdf",
        "report.docx",
        "image.png"
      ],

    "message_id": {

    "attachment_id": {
```

```json
      "title": "Minimum Attendee Percentage",
      "description": "Minimum confidence percentage (0-100) for suggestions. Default: 50."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for finding meeting times."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_FORWARD_MESSAGE
Tool to forward a message. Use when you need to send an existing email to new recipients.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "ForwardMessageRequest",

      "human_parameter_name": "Message ID",
```

## OUTLOOK_FORWARD_USER_CALENDAR_EVENT
Tool to forward a calendar event from a specific user's calendar to new recipients. Use when you need to share an event from a particular calendar with additional people.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ForwardUserCalendarEventRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id",
    "to_recipients"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comment",
      "examples": [
        "Please review this event."
      ],
      "description": "An optional comment to include with the forwarded event invitation."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user identifier. Use 'me' for the authenticated user, or provide a Microsoft 365 User Principal Name (e.g., user@contoso.com) or Azure AD object ID."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ0AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mNKgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar event to forward. Must be a valid Outlook event ID obtained from list or get event actions."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar containing the event to forward. Obtain this from list calendars actions."
    },
    "to_recipients": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      "title": "To Recipients",
      "examples": [
        [
          "alice@example.com",
          "bob@example.com"
        ],
        [
          {
            "name": "Alice Smith",
            "address": "alice@example.com"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of recipients to forward the event to. Can provide email addresses as strings (e.g., 'alice@example.com') or as objects with 'address' and optional 'name' fields."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for forwarding a calendar event from a specific user's calendar."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_GET_CALENDAR_SCHEDULE
Tool to get free/busy schedule information for a specific calendar. Use when you need to check availability for users or resources within a calendar's time window.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCalendarScheduleRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_id",
    "schedules",
    "startTime",
    "endTime"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "endTime": {
      "type": "object",

          ],

        },

            "UTC",
            "Pacific Standard Time",
            "Eastern Standard Time"
          ],

        }
      },
      "description": "The end date, time, and time zone for the period to retrieve schedules. Period can be up to 62 days from start.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",

    },
    "schedules": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Schedules",
      "examples": [
        [
          "user1@example.com",
          "room1@example.com"
        ],
        [
          "testcompud@outlook.com"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A collection of SMTP addresses of users, distribution lists, or resources to get availability information for. Maximum of 20 addresses."
    },
    "startTime": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Start Time",
      "required": [
        "dateTime",
        "timeZone"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "dateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2025-01-20T09:00:00",
            "2025-02-20T14:30:00"
          ],
          "description": "Date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2025-01-20T09:00:00')."
        },
        "timeZone": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Zone",
          "examples": [
            "UTC",
            "Pacific Standard Time",
            "Eastern Standard Time"
          ],
          "description": "IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'UTC') or Windows timezone name (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time')."
        }
      },
      "description": "The start date, time, and time zone for the period to retrieve schedules. Period can be up to 62 days.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA=",
        "AAMkAGI2TG93AAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar to query. Use LIST_CALENDARS action to get calendar IDs."
    },
    "availabilityViewInterval": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Availability View Interval",
      "default": 30,
      "maximum": 1440,
      "minimum": 5,
      "examples": [
        15,

        60
      ],
      "description": "Duration of a time slot in minutes. Minimum: 5, Maximum: 1440. Default: 30."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for retrieving free/busy schedule information for a specific calendar."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_GET_CALENDAR_VIEW
Get events ACTIVE during a time window (includes multi-day events). Use for "what's on my calendar today/this week" or availability checks. Returns events overlapping the time range. For keyword search or filters by category, use OUTLOOK_LIST_EVENTS instead.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetCalendarViewRequest",

    "start_datetime",
    "end_datetime"

      "human_parameter_name": "Select Properties",

Must be an IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Kolkata') or Windows timezone identifier (e.g., 'Pacific Standard Time', 'India Standard Time'). UTC offsets like '+05:30' or 'GMT+5' are NOT supported. Defaults to UTC.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Timezone",
      "human_parameter_description": "The time zone to use when showing event times in the results. Use IANA names (like 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Kolkata') or Windows names (like 'Pacific Standard Time'). UTC offsets like '+05:30' are not supported."
```

## OUTLOOK_GET_CHILD_FOLDER_MESSAGE
Tool to retrieve a specific email message from a child mail folder. Use when you need to access a message in a nested folder hierarchy.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetChildFolderMessageRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "child_folder_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "select": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        [
          "id",
          "subject",
          "from",
          "receivedDateTime",
          "webLink"
        ],
        [
          "subject",
          "body",
          "from",
          "toRecipients",
          "hasAttachments"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of message properties to include in the response. OData $select parameter. Reduces data transfer and improves performance. Common fields: id, subject, from, toRecipients, ccRecipients, receivedDateTime, sentDateTime, body, bodyPreview, hasAttachments, webLink, internetMessageHeaders, isRead, importance, categories. Leave empty to return all fields."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "User's email address, UPN, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "Unique ID of the message to retrieve. Must be obtained from OUTLOOK_LIST_MAIL_FOLDER_MESSAGES, OUTLOOK_QUERY_EMAILS, or OUTLOOK_SEARCH_MESSAGES (use hitId from search results). The message must exist in the specified child folder."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "AAMkAGI0ZjExAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID or well-known name of the parent mail folder. Common well-known names include: 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems', 'deleteditems', 'junkemail', 'archive', 'outbox', 'clutter', 'conflicts', 'conversationhistory', 'localfailures', 'msgfolderroot', 'recoverableitemsdeletions', 'scheduled', 'searchfolders', 'serverfailures', 'syncissues'. For custom folders, use the actual folder ID (a base64-encoded string like 'AAMkAGI0ZjExAAA=') obtained from OUTLOOK_LIST_MAIL_FOLDERS."
    },

      "title": "Child Folder Id",
      "examples": [
```
