## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_CALENDAR_PERMISSION
Tool to update calendar permission levels for share recipients or delegates. Use when you need to change the access level (role) for someone who has been granted access to a calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCalendarPermissionRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_id",
    "permission_id",
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "freeBusyRead",
        "limitedRead",
        "read",
        "write"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "examples": [
        "write",
        "read"
      ],
      "description": "The permission level to change to for the calendar share recipient or delegate. Possible values: freeBusyRead (view free/busy status only), limitedRead (view free/busy status, titles and locations), read (view all details except private events), write (view all details except private events and edit events)."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "48d31887-5fad-4d73-a9f5-3c356e68a038"
      ],
      "description": "User ID, userPrincipalName, or 'me' for the authenticated user."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar."
    },
    "permission_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Permission Id",
      "examples": [
        "RGVmYXVsdA==",
        "OTc3ZGM5YTMtYjA5Yi00YzFkLThkMDUtZWM2N2Q5ZGIzN2Q0"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar permission to update. This ID can be obtained from listing calendar permissions."
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_CONTACT
Updates an existing Outlook contact, identified by `contact_id` for the specified `user_id`, requiring at least one other field to be modified.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateContactRequest",
  "required": [
    "contact_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Notes",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Met at the annual tech conference. Interested in collaboration."
      ],
      "description": "Personal notes about the contact (maps to 'personalNotes' in Microsoft Graph API).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Notes",
      "human_parameter_description": "Any personal notes about this contact. Use this to remember context like where you met or follow-up details."
    },
    "surname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Surname",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [

      "human_parameter_name": "Surname",

    },
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_CONTACT_FOLDER
Tool to update the properties of a contact folder for a specific user. Use when you need to rename or move an existing contact folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateContactFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "contact_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
      ],
      "description": "User principal name or ID. Use 'me' for the authenticated user."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Test Folder",
        "Work Contacts"
      ],
      "description": "The updated display name for the contact folder."
    },
    "parentFolderId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the folder's parent folder to move this contact folder under."
    },
    "contact_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mZIQAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the contact folder to update."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating a contact folder's properties for a specific user."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Display Name",
          "description": "The folder's display name."
        },
        "parentFolderId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Parent Folder Id",
          "description": "The ID of the folder's parent folder."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response schema for an updated contact folder."
    }
  },
  "title": "UpdateContactFolderResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_CONTACT_FOLDER_CHILD_FOLDER

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_EVENT_EXTENSION
Tool to update an open extension on a calendar event in Microsoft Graph. Use when you need to modify custom properties stored in an event extension.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateEventExtensionRequest",
  "required": [
    "calendar_id",
    "event_id",
    "extension_id",
    "extension_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "The user identifier for the calendar owner. Must be either 'me' (for the authenticated user), a Microsoft 365 User Principal Name (e.g., user@contoso.com), or an Azure AD object ID (GUID)."
    },
    "event_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkAGI2TAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar event containing the extension to update."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar containing the event."
    },
    "extension_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Id",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.TestExtension"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the extension to update. Can be the full extension ID (e.g., Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.TestExtension) or just the extension name (e.g., Com.Contoso.TestExtension)."
    },
    "extension_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Name",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Com.Contoso.CustomData"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the extension. Must match the format: 'Com.Company.ExtensionName'."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "dealValue": 200000,
          "companyName": "Contoso Updated",
          "expirationDate": "2027-01-15T00:00:00Z"
        },
        {
          "notes": "Important client meeting",
          "status": "active",
          "priority": 1
        }
      ],
      "description": "Custom properties to update in the extension. Each property can be a string, number, or boolean value. If not provided, only the extension name will be updated.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_CALENDAR_EVENT
Tool to update an event in a specific user's calendar. Use when you need to modify calendar event properties for a user other than the signed-in user.

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_CALENDAR_PERMISSION
Tool to update calendar permission levels for a specific user's calendar. Use when you need to change the access level (role) for someone who has been granted access to a user's calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserCalendarPermissionRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "permission_id",
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "role": {
      "enum": [
        "none",
        "freeBusyRead",
        "limitedRead",
        "read",
        "write"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Role",
      "examples": [
        "write",
        "read"
      ],
      "description": "The permission level to change to for the calendar share recipient or delegate. Possible values: none (remove access), freeBusyRead (view free/busy status only), limitedRead (view free/busy status, titles and locations), read (view all details except private events), write (view all details except private events and edit events)."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@contoso.com",
        "6640adbb5cb743b0"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID or principal name of the user whose calendar permission to update. Use 'me' for the authenticated user or provide a specific user ID/UPN."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACHO0AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar. If not provided, defaults to the user's primary calendar."
    },
    "permission_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Permission Id",
      "examples": [
        "ZGU5NWQyODQtZTA3ZS00YzMxLTljMjAtY2JhNTI5ZTFjOTcx",
        "RGVmYXVsdA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar permission to update. This ID can be obtained from listing calendar permissions."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating calendar permission for a specific user's calendar."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_CALENDARS
Tool to update properties of a specific calendar by ID for a specific user. Use when you need to rename a user's calendar, change its color theme, or set it as the default calendar.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserCalendarsRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "calendar_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Work Calendar",
        "Final Updated Calendar - Verified"
      ],
      "description": "The new display name for the calendar. Provide this to rename the calendar."
    },
    "color": {
      "enum": [
        "auto",
        "lightBlue",
        "lightGreen",
        "lightOrange",
        "lightGray",
        "lightYellow",
        "lightTeal",
        "lightPink",
        "lightBrown",
        "lightRed",
        "maxColor"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "CalendarColor",
      "description": "Color theme options for calendars in Outlook."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "testcompud@outlook.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID or userPrincipalName of the user whose calendar to update. Use 'me' for the authenticated user."
    },
    "calendar_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Calendar Id",
      "examples": [
        "AAMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQYAAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mRIgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the calendar to update. This is the calendar ID returned when listing calendars."
    },
    "isDefaultCalendar": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Default Calendar",
      "description": "Set to true to make this calendar the user's default calendar, false otherwise. The default calendar is where new events are created by default."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating a specific user's calendar properties by calendar ID."
}
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_CONTACT_EXTENSION
Tool to update an open extension on a contact in a user's contact folder. Use when you need to modify custom properties stored in a contact extension for a specific user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserContactExtensionRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "contact_folder_id",
    "contact_id",
    "extension_id",
    "extension_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "6640adbb5cb743b0",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Can be user ID or userPrincipalName."
    },
    "contact_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ4AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0nIvgAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the contact."
    },
    "extension_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Id",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.TestExtension"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the extension. Can be extension name (e.g., 'Com.Contoso.Referral') or fully qualified name (e.g., 'Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.Referral')."
    },
    "extension_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Name",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Com.Contoso.CustomData"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the extension. Must match the format: 'Com.Company.ExtensionName'."
    },
    "contact_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Contact Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ4AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the contact folder containing the contact."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "dealValue": 1000,
          "companyName": "Contoso",
          "newProperty": "newValue",
          "testProperty": "updatedValue"
        },
        {
          "notes": "Important contact",
          "status": "active",
          "priority": 1
        }
      ],
      "description": "Custom properties to update in the extension. Each property can be a string, number, or boolean value. For M365 resources like contacts, only specified properties are updated (unspecified ones remain unchanged). If not provided, only the extension name will be updated.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_MAIL_FOLDER_MESSAGE_EXTENSION
Tool to update an open extension on a message within a specific user's mail folder. Use when you need to modify custom properties stored in a message extension for a specific user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserMailFolderMessageExtensionRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "mail_folder_id",
    "message_id",
    "extension_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "john.doe@contoso.com",
        "87d349ed-44d7-43e1-9a83-5f2406dee5bd"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user or 'me' for the authenticated user. Can be a user principal name (UPN) or user ID."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ8AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0lx4wAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message containing the extension to update."
    },
    "extension_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Id",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.TestExtension"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier or name of the extension to update. Can be the full extension ID (e.g., 'Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.TestExtension') or just the extension name (e.g., 'Com.Contoso.TestExtension')."
    },
    "extension_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Name",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Com.Contoso.UpdatedExtension"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the extension. If provided, it will update the extension name. Must follow the format 'Com.Company.ExtensionName'."
    },
    "mail_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "inbox",
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ8AAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the mail folder containing the message. Can be a well-known folder name (e.g., 'inbox', 'drafts', 'sentitems') or a folder ID."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "status": "active",
          "dealValue": 250000,
          "companyName": "Contoso Updated",
          "expirationDate": "2027-12-31"
        },
        {
          "notes": "Important client message",
          "priority": 1,
          "completed": false
        }
      ],
      "description": "Custom properties to update in the extension. Each property can be a string, number, or boolean value. If not provided, only the extension name (if specified) will be updated.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_MAIL_FOLDER_MESSAGE_RULE
Tool to update a message rule in a user's mail folder. Use when you need to modify an existing rule's properties, conditions, actions, or exceptions for a specific user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserMailFolderMessageRuleRequest",
  "required": [
    "mail_folder_id",
    "rule_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "actions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MessageRuleActions",
      "properties": {
        "delete": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Delete",
          "description": "Whether to delete matching messages."
        },
        "forwardTo": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Forward To",
          "examples": [
            [
              "assistant@company.com"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of email addresses to forward matching messages to.",
          "human_parameter_name": "Forward To"
        },
        "markAsRead": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Mark As Read",
          "description": "Whether to mark matching messages as read."
        },
        "copyToFolder": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Copy To Folder",
          "examples": [
            "AAMkAGI2NGNjOTExLTg0Y2ItNGIzYi05Y2Q0LWEwY2I4YWI1N2I4MQAuAAAAAACzMsPHYH6HQoSwfdpDx-2bAQCiGq-PkzMrQqW_3OC5Q5fDAAABBjsWAAA="
          ],
          "description": "Folder ID to copy matching messages to.",
          "human_parameter_name": "Copy To Folder"
        },
        "moveToFolder": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Move To Folder",
          "examples": [
            "AAMkAGI2NGNjOTExLTg0Y2ItNGIzYi05Y2Q0LWEwY2I4YWI1N2I4MQAuAAAAAACzMsPHYH6HQoSwfdpDx-2bAQCiGq-PkzMrQqW_3OC5Q5fDAAABBjsWAAA="
          ],
          "description": "Folder ID to move matching messages to.",
          "human_parameter_name": "Move To Folder"
        },
        "assignCategories": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "title": "Assign Categories",
          "examples": [
            [
              "Important",
              "Work"
            ]
          ],
          "description": "List of categories to assign to matching messages.",
          "human_parameter_name": "Assign Categories"
        },
        "stopProcessingRules": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Stop Processing Rules",
          "examples": [
            true,
            false
          ],
          "description": "If true, stops processing other rules after this rule's actions execute. Useful for priority rules where you want to prevent lower-priority rules from running. Example: High-priority sender rule that moves to VIP folder and stops other filing rules.",
          "human_parameter_name": "Stop Processing Rules"
        }
      },
      "description": "Updated actions to take when the rule conditions are met.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "rule_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rule Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQAAAE-SSTc=",
        "AAMkAGI2NGNjOTExLTg0Y2ItNGIzYi05Y2Q0LWEwY2I4YWI1N2I4MQAuAAAAAACzMsPHYH6HQoSwfdpDx-2bAQCiGq-PkzMrQqW_3OC5Q5fDAAABBjsWAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the message rule to update."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "User's identifier; 'me' for the signed-in user, or user's principal name/ID."
    },
    "sequence": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Sequence",
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        5
      ],
      "description": "Updated order in which the rule is executed (lower numbers execute first)."
    },
    "isEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Enabled",
      "description": "Whether the rule should be enabled or disabled."
    },
    "conditions": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MessageRulePredicates",
      "properties": {
        "importance": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Importance",
          "examples": [
            "high",
            "normal",
            "low"
          ],
          "description": "Message importance level to match (low, normal, high).",
          "human_parameter_name": "Importance"
        },
        "bodyContains": {
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_MAIL_FOLDERS_CHILD_FOLDERS
Tool to update a child folder within a mail folder for a specific user. Use when you need to rename a child mail folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserMailFoldersChildFoldersRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "mail_folder_id",
    "child_folder_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "6640adbb5cb743b0"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Use 'me' for the authenticated user or the user's ID/userPrincipalName."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",

        "Updated Child Folder Name",
        "Important Emails"
      ],

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQwAAAA="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the parent mail folder."
    },
    "child_folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Child Folder Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAC4AAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKAQDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0mZKAAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the child folder to update."

  },

}
```

## OUTLOOK_UPDATE_USER_MESSAGE_EXTENSION
Tool to update an open extension on a user's message. Use when you need to modify custom properties stored in a message extension for a specific user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateUserMessageExtensionRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "message_id",
    "extension_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "john.doe@contoso.com",
        "87d349ed-44d7-43e1-9a83-5f2406dee5bd"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user or 'me' for the authenticated user. Can be a user principal name (UPN) or user ID."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "AQMkADAwATMwMAExLTlmNjktOWVmYS0wMAItMDAKAEYAAAPLkCuWz0mbS4RvWyTvc1LKBwDGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAACAQ8AAADGTYrvat2PSKIu8IS9hMqyAAAAU0lyEAAAAA=="
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message containing the extension to update."
    },
    "extension_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Id",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.TestExtension"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier or name of the extension to update. Can be the full extension ID (e.g., 'Microsoft.OutlookServices.OpenTypeExtension.Com.Contoso.TestExtension') or just the extension name (e.g., 'Com.Contoso.TestExtension')."
    },
    "extension_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Extension Name",
      "examples": [
        "Com.Contoso.TestExtension",
        "Com.Contoso.UpdatedExtension"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the extension. If provided, it will update the extension name. Must follow the format 'Com.Company.ExtensionName'."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "status": "active",
          "dealValue": 250000,
          "companyName": "Contoso Updated",
          "expirationDate": "2027-12-31"
        },
        {
          "notes": "Important client message",
          "priority": 1,
          "completed": false
        }
      ],
      "description": "Custom properties to update in the extension. Each property can be a string, number, or boolean value. If not provided, only the extension name (if specified) will be updated.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "type": "string"
          },
          {
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "type": "number"
          },
          {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```
